gloss: rise and fall; prosperity and decline

definitions.gloss: rise and fall; prosperity and decline
definitions.explanation: The natural cycle of flourishing and declining over time.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}の{盛衰|せいすい}は{時代|じだい}とともに{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The rise and fall of companies changes with the times.

examples.japanese: {盛衰|せいすい}は{世|よ}の{常|つね}だ。
examples.english: Rise and fall is the way of the world.

examples.japanese: {文化|ぶんか}の{盛衰|せいすい}を{研究|けんきゅう}する。
examples.english: To research the rise and decline of cultures.

notes:
{盛衰|せいすい} means rise and fall or the cycle of prosperity and decline.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {盛|せい}: flourishing, prosperous
- {衰|すい}: decline, wane

IDIOMS:
- {盛衰|せいすい}は{世|よ}の{常|つね}: rise and fall is the way of the world
- {栄枯|えいこ}{盛衰|せいすい}: the vicissitudes of life (flourishing and withering)

USAGE:
Often used for discussing historical events, empires, companies, or civilizations over time.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {興亡|こうぼう}: rise and fall (often for nations/empires)
- {浮沈|ふちん}: ups and downs
- {栄枯|えいこ}: prosperity and decline
